description: This file defines the ExceptionLoggingSubscriber class, which implements event handling for logging exceptions in a Drupal project, including specific handling for 403, 404, and other HTTP errors.

classes.name: ExceptionLoggingSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to exception events and logs various types of errors, including 403, 404, 500, and other HTTP errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger channel factory.

methods.name: on403
methods.description: Logs 403 access denied errors with request URI information.

methods.name: on404
methods.description: Logs 404 page not found errors with request URI.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Logs general PHP errors and critical exceptions, including HTTP 500 errors.

methods.name: onClientError
methods.description: Logs 4xx client errors other than 403 and 404.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Determines the appropriate error handling method based on exception type and status code, then invokes it.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the onException method to handle exception events with a priority of 50.
